name: Adjustable capacitor
summary: An adjustable capacitor provides a documented variable capacitance.
description: An adjustable capacitor provides a documented variable capacitance. Its control or preset adjustment is specified separately from the two main circuit terminals.
readingNotes: Identify whether adjustment is operational or a commissioning preset.
